questions.stem: Why does a person who does heavy manual work need more energy in their diet than an office worker of the same age?

options.text: Their muscles need more energy for contraction during physical activity
They sweat more and lose energy through their skin
They need more vitamins for brain function

questions.explanation: Manual workers use their muscles more, which requires more energy from respiration. This means they need a greater energy intake from food to balance their higher energy expenditure.
